The controlled CPU branch preserves the original source. No-extra-E coarse
run reproduces every original probe column exactly. Changing only outer B
ghosts to Br proportional to r^-2 and Bt to r^-1 changes comet incident flux
by at most 0.00037% in the observation window; global weighted h divB/B
improves modestly (.05165 to .04564). Thus this outer-boundary defect does
not explain this particular coarse comet-flow discrepancy, although the
magnetic boundary is better posed with scaling.

A full-sphere minimal inductive electric correction for daily map evolution
changes coarse global-LLF comet incident flux by at most 2.55%. It is an
optional closure: native staggered fields cancel the map Faraday residual,
but this code interpolates cell-centred columns and retains ~30% of that
residual. Signs, units, time intervals, rotation/seam interpolation and
retarded initialization were independently checked. The changed radial
Maxwell stress has RMS about 0.1% of ram pressure. Neither this closure nor
frozen-Br controls eliminate the larger transport-method sensitivity.

Independent Athena++ hydro with the actual rotating boundary also lacks
full refinement convergence (72 to 96 changes PN incident mean by -10.47%,
up to24.5% pointwise). This establishes that the concern exists at B=0.
The CUDA float64 port has passed five tiny CPU/GPU agreement checks,
including optional E and both flux formulations; a full coarse comparison
is in progress before larger jobs. Device data cap2.3GB, host RSS guard3GiB,
one CUDA production job at a time, short kernels, no exclusive device.
